instruction: Save a screenshot of the video scene to the Desktop with the filename 'space_station.png'.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot and saving with a specific filename 'space_station.png' on Desktop. Evaluator verifies: (1) file exists at correct location, (2) filename matches exactly, (3) file is valid PNG format. State-based evaluation without external image comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file state from the expected path (/home/user/Desktop/space_station.png)
Metric properly handles 'expected' parameter - directly accesses expected.get('filename') which is correct for type='rule'
All instruction requirements are verified: file existence (40%), exact filename match (30%), valid PNG format (30%)
Scoring logic is well-balanced and provides meaningful partial credit
Getter robustly validates PNG format using PIL Image.open() and checks image properties
Error handling is appropriate with try-except blocks and logging
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: Evaluator cannot verify that the screenshot contains actual video content (vs. any arbitrary PNG), but this is acceptable given the constraint of state-based evaluation without external image comparison as noted in metadata
